title: Private same-release d1 and exact composition
question: Can the locked private d1 path settle released questions and deliver their exact source, parser alternatives and unresolved states?
method: Deploy the bound native descriptor on development. Reuse the native book source, derive parser inputs on two views, run seven d1 scopes and verify the Reader, MCP and selected exact detached proof.
commands: uv run ci model change deploy 65faefe54c214af79541357fd9082c1d --json
uv run ci contributions list --run 422 --method extract.pm2_d1 --include-details --include-interpretation --limit 100 --page-bytes 4000000 --json
uv run ci review inspect --result a96885c8f28f409da4547ac540de87d1 --json

outputs.role: Scoped outcomes, exact composition and detached custody

conclusion: Seven scopes settled and selected delivery/closure passed. Passage function and exact literal location survived. Numeric normalization, qualifier host recovery and local referent recovery did not. This does not qualify adoption.
